rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each community is summoned with a witness or guide representing the perfection it recognizes, such as a prophet, imam, religion, or book.
rows.anchor: طائفة من الأمم مع شاهدهم الذي يحضرهم ويتوجهون إليه من الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prefixed باء may mean that people come with their imam, or that they are attributed to and summoned by the imam's name because love of him dominates them.
rows.anchor: سواء كان في صورة نبي آمنوا به كما ذكر في تفسير قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Receiving the book in the right hand signifies receiving it from the rational, stronger side and appearing among the blessed; such people can read because they are prepared to understand.
rows.anchor: من جهة العقل الذي هو أقوى جانبيه وبعث في صورة السعداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The left hand signifies the weaker, lower self; its recipients cannot read amid loss of reason and extreme bewilderment.
rows.anchor: من جهة النفس التي هي أضعف جانبيه لا يقدر على قراءة كتابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one is shortchanged in even the smallest part of the forms of their deeds, perfections, or character traits.
rows.anchor: لا ينقصون من صور أعمالهم وكمالاتهم وأخلاقهم شيئا قليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One blind to guidance in this life remains blind in the next and is more lost, since worldly faculties and opportunities for acquiring guidance will then be gone.
rows.anchor: له في هذه الحياة آلات وأدوات وأسبابا يمكنه الاهتداء بها وهو في مقام الكسب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The near yielding is a spiritual fluctuation: the Prophet's intense desire for his people's faith made him almost incline to some requests contrary to the law to win their affection and guidance.
rows.anchor: لفرط شغفه وحرصه على إيمانهم بوجود القلب كاد يميل إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He hoped accommodation would soften their denial and open their hearts; God corrected and steadied him.
rows.anchor: واستمالة وتطييبا لقلوبهم عسى أن يلينوا وينزلوا عن شدة إنكارهم

rows.speaker: عائشة رضي الله عنها
rows.claim: Aisha said that the Prophet's character was the Quran; Qashani reads this to mean revelation corrected every passing inclination until the Prophet reached stability.
rows.anchor: تعني أنه عليه الصلاة والسلام كلما ظهرت نفسه وهمت بما ليس بفضيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani cites other divine corrections to argue that much of the Prophet's post-arrival prophetic conduct was still spiritual wayfaring.
rows.anchor: يدل على أنه كان أكثر سلوكه في الله بعد الوصول في زمان النبوة وزمان الوحي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had the Prophet approached their temptation, he would have received doubled punishment in life and death; punishment rises with rank and preparedness because loss answers the pleasure of perfection.
rows.anchor: فإن شدة العذاب بحسب علو المرتبة وقوة الاستعداد إذ النقصان الموجب للعذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The more complete one's readiness and perception, the greater both the possible perfection and joy and the corresponding deprivation and pain.
rows.anchor: فكلما كان الاستعداد أتم والإدراك أقوى، كانت المرتبة في الكمال والسعادة واللذة أقوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer has five inward forms and stations: intimate communion in hiddenness, witnessing in spirit, confidential converse in the secret, presence in the heart, and compliant submission in the self.
rows.anchor: اعلم أن الصلاة على خمسة أقسام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun's decline marks unity's withdrawal from the servant's existence after annihilation; no prayer is possible at complete annihilation because prayer requires a praying servant.
rows.anchor: فدلوك الشمس هو علامة زوال شمس الوحدة عن الاستواء على وجود العبد بالفناء المحض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At decline, the servant's shadow or existence returns, whether veiled by creation before union or abiding after union; prayer then continues until the self's night and the heart's dawn.
rows.anchor: إذا حدث ظل وجود العبد سواء عند الاحتجاب بالخلق حالة الفرق قبل الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gentlest prayer is intimate communion; the most excellent is the spirit's witnessing, identified with the middle prayer and interpreted as the afternoon prayer.
rows.anchor: وأفضلها وأشرفها صلاة الشهود للروح المشار إليها بصلاة العصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The secret's confidential prayer is the brief sunset interval when the heart first appears behind a veil; the short interval explains the recommendation to shorten sunset recitation.
rows.anchor: وأوحاها وأخفها صلاة السر بالمناجاة أول وقت الاحتجاب بظهور القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dawn recitation is the heart's presence, during disclosure of attributes and unveilings; congregation and longer recitation are especially recommended then, when night and day angels attend.
rows.anchor: فإنها في وقت تجليات أنوار الصفات ونزول المكاشفات ولهذا استحب التكثر في جماعة صلاة الصبح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dawn prayer signals the heart's qualities and light descending as the self's qualities recede; it is witnessed because angels of night and day are present.
rows.anchor: محضورا بحضور ملائكة الليل والنهار إشارة إلى نزول صفات القلب وأنوارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night prayer most firmly tames the self, so silence after it until sleep is prescribed except for remembrance; loud prayer rebukes Satan where he can whisper, while the spirit's hidden station calls for quiet.
rows.anchor: سن فيما جعل آية لها من صلاة العشاء السكوت بعدها حتى النوم إلا بذكر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night vigil is an extra obligation for the Prophet and marks the self's station, which especially needs worship; followers learn to discipline their selves and he gains stability.
rows.anchor: لزيادة احتياج هذا المقام إلى الصلاة بالنسبة إلى سائر المقامات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The praised station is the completion of sainthood with the Mahdi's appearance; the prophetic seal is praised as a seal of prophecy but not from the aspect of sealing sainthood, while the completed sainthood seal is praised in every respect.
rows.anchor: في مقام يجب على الكل حمده وهو مقام ختم الولاية بظهور المهدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Entering in truth is entry into unity and the gathered state without turning to another, self-assertion, or duality; exiting in truth is returning to multiplicity without self-colored fluctuation or deviation from justice.
rows.anchor: ولا الطغيان بظهور الأنائية ولا شوب الاثنينية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The supporting authority is a proof that establishes and stabilizes the Prophet in abiding through God rather than himself; alternatively it is God-given power to make His religion prevail.
rows.anchor: بأن أكون بك في الأشياء في حال البقاء بعد الفناء لا بنفسي

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The Prophet prayed not to be left to himself even for a moment.
rows.anchor: لا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Real is necessary, stable existence; the human, contingent existence is changeable and perishing, and its perishing is original rather than a later event.
rows.anchor: الوجود الثابت الواجب الحقاني الذي لا يتغير ولا يتبدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The enduring has always endured and the transient has always been transient; a false supposition veiled this truth until it was unveiled.
rows.anchor: بل الفاني فان في الأزل والباقي باق لم يزل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quranic intellect is unfolded gradually as details of the discriminating intellect, disclosing what was collectively concealed in the Prophet according to the manifestation of attributes.
rows.anchor: نفصل ما في ذاتك مجملا مكنونا تفصيلا بارزا ظاهرا عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For believers prepared to trust the unseen, this disclosure heals ignorance, doubt, hypocrisy, blindness of heart, rancor, envy, and similar illnesses, and grants virtues, wisdom, and knowledge.
rows.anchor: ليكون شفاء لأمراض قلوب المستعدين المؤمنين بالغيب من أمتك كالجهل والشك والنفاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For those with deficient readiness and bodily or selfish veils, the Quran increases denial, obstinacy, hypocrisy, and other forms of loss by making their deficient selves more manifest.
rows.anchor: الناقصين استعدادهم بالرذائل والحجب الظلمانية الباخسين حظوظهم من الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At blessings, a person fixed on self and body sees only immediate material effects, grows proud, and turns away from the Real.
rows.anchor: لوقوفه مع النفس والبدن وكون القوى البدنية متناهية لا تتدبر الأمور الغير المتناهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At harm, a person despairs because the veil hides the all-powerful God; insight would recognize God's power in both states.
rows.anchor: وكذا في جانب الشر إذا مسه يئس لاحتجابه عن القادر وقدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The discerning response is gratitude, which binds blessings, and patience, which repels calamities: thank the Giver without arrogance or forgetfulness, and hope for relief without despair.
rows.anchor: وفي الثانية أن الصبر دفاع النقم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person's dominant nature and station shape their actions: the self produces turning away and despair, while the heart's virtuous disposition produces gratitude and patience.
rows.anchor: فمن كان مقامه النفس وشاكلته مقتضى طباعها عمل ما ذكرنا من الإعراض واليأس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows which people follow the heart's guidance and which follow the self's nature, and recompenses each according to action.
rows.anchor: فيجازيهما بحسب أعمالهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit belongs to the divine command, the realm of immaterial essences, beyond bodily people's sensory categories of shape, color, direction, and place; the veiled cannot grasp it.
rows.anchor: الذوات المجردة عن الهيولى والجواهر المقدسة عن الشكل واللون والجهة والأين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The little knowledge people receive is sensory knowledge, insignificant beside God's knowledge and that of those firmly rooted in knowledge.
rows.anchor: هو علم المحسوسات وذلك شيء نزر حقير بالنسبة إلى علم الله تعالى والراسخين في العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God could remove revelation by effacement in annihilation or veil it after disclosure through spiritual fluctuation, with no agent able to restore it.
rows.anchor: بالطمس في محل الفناء أو الحجب بعد الكشف بالتلوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only a special, immense mercy protects the Prophet: the mercy of the Merciful grants him complete perfection and sustains his existence and revelation.
rows.anchor: مجرد رحمة عظيمة خاصة بك من فرط عنايتنا وهي أعلى مراتب الرحمة الرحيمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A direct manifestation of the divine essence would leave neither revelation nor the Prophet's self; manifestation through mercy brings both into being, while majesty can veil revelation and knowledge.
rows.anchor: لو تجلينا بذاتنا لما وجدت الوحي ولا ذاتك إلا إذا تجلينا بصفة الرحمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great favor is eternal: revelation and divine teaching came after the gift of necessary existence.
rows.anchor: بالإيحاء والتعليم الرباني بعد موهبة الوجود الحقاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one can produce this Quran because its complete spiritual readiness is uniquely the Prophet's; others receive only what overflows from him and cannot bear its fullness.
rows.anchor: لكون الاستعداد الكامل الحامل له مخصوصا بك وأنت قطب العالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most people persist in disbelief and demand bodily miracles suited to their limited readiness, such as springs, gardens, fragments of the sky, ascent, or angels.
rows.anchor: واقترحوا الآيات الجسمانية المناسبة لاستعدادهم وإدراكهم كتفجير العيون من الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Angels could not descend in their own immaterial form for people to perceive; embodied angels would be dismissed as human, so denial would persist either way.
rows.anchor: ما أمكن نزول الملائكة مع كونهم نفوسا مجردة على الهيئة الملكية في الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guidance belongs especially to those God guides through the light of primordial, eternal care; those deprived of it have no other protectors or guides.
rows.anchor: بمقتضى العناية الأزلية في الفطرة الأولى بنوره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unguided are raised face-down, either because they are drawn toward the lower realm or in the same state they had in worldly life, with all their qualities intact.
rows.anchor: أي على الحالة الأولى من غير زيادة ونقصان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are blind to guidance, mute because they cannot understand truth, and deaf to intelligible meaning; thus no inspiration, speech, or visual lesson can guide them.
rows.anchor: لعدم إدراكهم المعنى المراد بالنطق إذ ليسوا ذوي قلوب يفهم بها ويفقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is repeatedly intensified as in the cited verse, and more severely, because their veiling from God's attributes includes denial of resurrection and the power demonstrated by creating heaven and earth.
rows.anchor: بل أبلغ منه ذلك بسبب احتجابهم عن صفاتنا خصوصا قدرتنا على البعث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If people controlled God's treasuries they would hoard from innate miserliness, since the self sees only limited material goods and fears depletion of mercy it cannot perceive without guidance.
rows.anchor: لوقوفكم مع صفات نفوسكم التي من لوازمها الشح الجبلي لكون إدراكها مقصورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nine clear signs given to Moses were previously indicated in Surat al-Hijr.
rows.anchor: مرت الإشارة إليها في سورة (الحجر)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran descended after the Prophet's humanity was effaced in annihilation and the contingent veil cleared, then its differentiated detail appeared in the abiding state.
rows.anchor: ما أنزلنا القرآن إلا بعد زوال بشرية النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالكلية في مقام الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qashani reads the first باء as accompanying or describing truth, either reality and wisdom or God; the second باء is locative, as in arriving at Baghdad.
rows.anchor: وإما بالحق الذي هو الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran is divided according to the varying readiness of its manifestations, which determines what each can receive in each state and circumstance.
rows.anchor: على حسب ظهور استعدادات المظاهر المقتضية لقبوله بحسب الأحوال والمصالح والصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The invitation to believe or disbelieve underscores that the rejecters count as nothing; the meaningful response is that of people endowed with knowledge and standing before God.
rows.anchor: ليس المراد منه هدايتكم لكونكم مطبوعا على قلوبكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those given knowledge before the Quran fall prostrate when it is recited, recognizing it through prepared, luminous capacity and certainty that it fulfills the promised divine book.
rows.anchor: ينقادون له ويعترفون به ويعرفون حقيقته لعلمهم به ومعرفتهم إياه بنورية الاستعداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their humility increases because they are receptive to the Quran and yield gently to its authority.
rows.anchor: باللين والانقياد لحكمه لتأثرهم به وحسن تلقيهم لقبوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Invoking Allah signifies annihilation in the all-comprehensive essence, while invoking al-Rahman signifies annihilation in the attribute that is the source of attributes; in either station the invoker's separate self disappears.
rows.anchor: بالفناء في الصفة التي هي أم الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At witnessing, do not loudly claim prayer as your own and assert the self, or become so silent in annihilation that abiding and the possibility of following disappear; seek a just, steady way in multiplicity.
rows.anchor: يدل على الاستقامة ولزوم سيرة العدالة في عالم الكثرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise manifests divine perfections and merciful attributes, which belong only to the one essence.
rows.anchor: أظهر الكمالات الإلهية والصفات الرحمانية التي لا تكون إلا للذات الأحدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has no child: an effect is contingent and dependent, so it cannot be of the same kind as the necessary being.
rows.anchor: لم يكن علة لموجود من جنسه لضرورة كون المعلول محتاجا إليه ممكنا بالذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A partner in sovereignty would either share necessary existence, making both composite and contingent, or fail the tests of independent causal power; hence there is no coequal.
rows.anchor: فلزم تركبهما فكانا كلاهما ممكنين لا واجبين وأيضا فإن لم يستقلا بالتأثير لم يكن أحدهما إلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has no helper from weakness or need, since needing a supporter would make Him contingent; magnify Him beyond restriction to any attribute or form, in a way no other can measure.
rows.anchor: ناصر علة كان أو جزء علة تقويه وتنصره من ذلة الانفال والعدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In praising God for the book's descent, He praises Himself in differentiated form from the perspective of unity: He is both praiser and praised in unity and detail.
rows.anchor: أثنى الله تعالى بلسان التفصيل على نفسه باعتبار الجمع من حيث كونه منعوتا بإنزال الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was eternally singled out as God's servant and prepared to receive the complete book; descent unfolds unified realities in his human manifestation, while his ascent returns their meaning as praise.
rows.anchor: قابلة للكمال المطلق من فيضه وإيداع كتاب الجمع فيه بالقوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God first praised Himself in unity through differentiation, then said Praise belongs to God; the Prophet's praise depends on God's prior disclosure, as expressed in the transmitted prayer.
rows.anchor: لا أحصي ثناء عليك أنت كما أثنيت على نفسك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book has no crookedness, meaning no deviation toward another; the Prophet's sight saw no other in witnessing.
rows.anchor: لم ير الغير في شهوده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book is upright because the Prophet is made unified and annihilated in God without another veiling his witnessing, then remains upright in abiding.
rows.anchor: جعله موحدا فانيا فيه غير محتجب في شهوده بالغير ولا بنفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, he is made responsible for servants' guidance: perfecting others follows one's own perfection, and Abraham was called a community; this task belongs to the Prophet's commanded uprightness.
rows.anchor: أو جعله قيما بأمر العباد وهدايتهم إذ التكميل يترتب على الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning is general because all face divine overpowering; that overpowering can be sheer punishment for the veiled or outward severity with inward grace for monotheists in annihilation.
rows.anchor: قهر محض ظاهره وباطنه قهر كالمختص بالمحجوبين بالشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ali says God's punishment can be severe on enemies amid abundant blessings and mercy can be wide for friends amid severe punishment; believers are identified as monotheists opposite those claiming God has a child.
rows.anchor: سبحان من اشتدت نقمته على أعدائه في سعة نعمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Righteous deeds are enduring good works and virtues; their good reward comes from the garden of effects and actions merited through works.
rows.anchor: الباقيات من الخيرات والفضائل لأن الأجر الحسن هو من جنة الآثار والأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Warning and glad tidings complete the Prophet's guidance and result from divine severity and gentleness; the servant is prepared to receive them through the dispositions of anger and desire.
rows.anchor: الإنذار والتبشير اللذين هما من باب التكميل اللازم لكونه قيما عليهم كلاهما أثر ونتيجة عن صفتي القهر واللطف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those two dispositions disappear when their divine counterparts are fully acquired; courage and chastity likewise require their corresponding capacities, and effusion comes only to a receptive locus.
rows.anchor: فعند ارتواء القلب منهما وكمال التخلق بهما حدث عن القهر الإنذار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim of God's child has no knowledge behind it, only extreme ignorance and imitation of ancestors; the huge word spoken has no meaning in their hearts.
rows.anchor: ما لهم بهذا القول من علم بل إنما يصدر عن جهل مفرط وتقليد للآباء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Necessary, singular being cannot have a contingent effect as a similar child; witnessing entails creation's annihilation in the Real, and the cited poet denies any existence beside God.
rows.anchor: الوجود الواجبي العلي أحدي الذات لا يماثله الوجود الممكن المعلول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim is a lie because rational proof and experiential witnessing both establish its impossibility.
rows.anchor: لتطابق الدليل العقلي والوجدان الذوقي الشهودي على إحالته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet nearly destroyed himself grieving their rejection; compassion for God's creatures follows from love of God, and as God's beloved he loved God deeply.
rows.anchor: لأن الشفقة على خلق الله والرحمة عليهم من لوازم محبة الله ونتائجه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In true witnessing, people were like his children, relatives, or limbs; greater love for the Real intensified his compassion, and his connection to the Beloved could open hearts to God's love.
rows.anchor: فإنهم كأولاده وأقاربه بل كأعضائه وجوارحه في الشهود الحقيقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When people rejected the Quran, the Prophet felt his own state deficient and sought to subdue the self, out of compassion and reverence for God, blaming his own state rather than their readiness.
rows.anchor: وكان ذلك من فرط شفقته عليهم وكمال أدبه مع الله حيث أحال عدم إيمانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God consoles him: adornments on earth, including the body's self, pleasures, powers, perceptions, and desires, are a test of who best resists them for God's sake.
rows.anchor: إنا جعلنا ما على أرض البدن من النفس ولذاتها وشهواتها وقوى صفاتها وإدراكاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God can reduce the world's adornment to a barren plain by divine manifestation and the annihilation of its qualities, through true or natural death, without injustice or loss.
rows.anchor: ثم نفنيها ولا حيف ولا نقص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cave people are seven perfected spiritual poles, ever present to sustain the world, corresponding to the seven moving planets and governing meaning and the ordering of the material world.
rows.anchor: أصحاب الكهف هم السبعة الكمل القائمون بأمر الحق دائما الذين يقوم بهم العالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cave may mean the body's interior, the inscribed tablet its sensory exterior, the dog the animal soul, the town the upper world, and the mountain valley the bodily world, depending on interpretive reports.
rows.anchor: والكهف هو باطن البدن والرقيم ظاهره الذي انتقش بصور الحواس والأعضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seven may also be the famous prophets across successive eras, ending with Muhammad, whose lunar miracle marked the seal of prophecy and completion of the divine religion.
rows.anchor: آدم وإدريس ونوح وإبراهيم وموسى وعيسى ومحمد عليهم الصلاة والسلام

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says time has returned to its original arrangement at the creation of the heavens and earth.
rows.anchor: إن الزمان قد استدار كهيئته يوم خلق الله السموات والأرض

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet likens the completion of prophecy to a building with one brick remaining, identifying himself as that final brick.
rows.anchor: بقي منه موضع لبنة واحدة

rows.speaker: الحكماء المتألهة من قدماء الفرس
rows.claim: Ancient Persian theosophers held that descending ranks of intellects and spirits have increasingly doubled illuminations; Qashani applies this to later temporal figures gathering more lights and perfections.
rows.anchor: وقد اتفق الحكماء المتألهة من قدماء الفرس أن مراتب العقول والأرواح على مذهبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad gathers the qualities of all who came before him; Abraham is the central pole of prophecy as manifestation of greatest unity, and Muhammad truly follows him despite appearing later in time.
rows.anchor: كان مظهر التوحيد الأعظمي الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Primordial spirits occupy fixed ranks and differing readiness through original divine care; their nearness determines recognition, affinity, and eventual degrees of perfection in bodies.
rows.anchor: فأهل الصف الأول هم السابقون المفردون المقربون المحبوبون المخصوصون بفضل عنايته

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: The Prophet compares people to mines of gold and silver, an image Qashani uses for the varying ranks of primordial readiness.
rows.anchor: الناس معادن كمعادن الذهب والفضة

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: When Abu Yazid asked whether the Prophet was one of the seven, the Prophet answered that he was the seven.
rows.anchor: سأله أبو يزيد رحمة الله عليه: أنت من السبعة؟ فقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أنا السبعة

rows.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
rows.claim: The Prophet says his light was the first created and that he was a prophet while Adam was between water and clay, supporting his priority in rank rather than temporal appearance.
rows.anchor: أول ما خلق الله نوري وكنت نبيا وآدم بين الماء والطين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prophets differ in spirit, heart, and self without differing in their unity of essential reality; temporal separation does not prevent eternal co-presence.
rows.anchor: فالحاصل أن اختلافهم وتباينهم روحا وقلبا ونفسا لا ينافي اتحادهم في الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the seven are the five faculties plus the secret and hidden spirit.
rows.anchor: فتلك الخمسة مع السر والخفاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation of three companions is spirit, intellect, and heart.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى الروح والعقل والقلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation of five adds theoretical and practical intellects and prophetic or reflective power to spirit and heart.
rows.anchor: الروح والقلب والعقل النظري والعقل العملي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dog is the self that remains at the cave's entrance.
rows.anchor: والكلب هي النفس الملازمة لباب الكهف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If opponents prevail, they stone the believers with passions of anger, desire, and pleasure, blocking their perfection, or return them to the creed through imagination, Satan, and worship of idols.
rows.anchor: بحجارة الأهواء والدواعي من الغضب والشهوة وطلب اللذة فيقتلوكم بمنعكم عن كمالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the first inward reading, the opponents are ordinary people, blind traditionalists, crude literalists, and those fixed in falsehood; their historical hostility to the people of truth is also acknowledged.
rows.anchor: التأويل الأول ظهور العوام، واستيلاء المقلدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers are those of essential unity, contrasted with associators; their righteous deeds are actions pursued for their own sake in the station of upright abiding.
rows.anchor: من الأعمال المقصودة لذاتها في مقام الاستقامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not waste their reward; the shift from pronoun to explicit mention indicates reward is merited through action, while knowledge raises rank.
rows.anchor: وضع الظاهر موضع المضمر للدلالة على أن الأجر إنما يستحق بالعمل دون العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gardens are the three gardens; gold bracelets signify realities of essential unity and self-disclosure, while silver bracelets signify luminous attributes.
rows.anchor: هي من حقائق التوحيد الذاتي ومعاني التجليات العينية الأحدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Green garments symbolize joyful, beautiful, fresh qualities; fine silk is subtle states and gifts, while brocade is denser character and acquired merit.
rows.anchor: يتصفون بصفات بهيجة، حسنة، نضرة، موجبة للسرور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reclining couches are divine names, the sources of acts; the recipients embody divine qualities in the garden of attributes and actions.
rows.anchor: أرائك الأسماء الإلهية التي هي مبادئ أفعاله لاتصافهم بأوصافه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains are the body's limbs reduced to scattered dust, and the body's earth becomes an exposed, level plain without form or structure.
rows.anchor: نذهب جبال الأعضاء بالتفتيت فنجعلها هباء منثورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gathered refer either to the faculties just described or to all people; they are displayed in ordered ranks and reminded they have returned bare, alone, as first created.
rows.anchor: الضمير إما للقوى المذكورة وإما لأفراد الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book is the embodied form of the mold, matching the lasting configurations of deeds in souls; wrongdoers fear finding what they forgot.
rows.anchor: كتاب القالب المطابق لما في نفوسهم من هيئات الأعمال الراسخة فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every movement and deed remains in souls and in the celestial soul-tablets, appearing in detail in the second existence, so none can evade the record and God wrongs no one.
rows.anchor: لكون آثار حركاتهم وأعمالهم كلها باقية في نفوسهم صغيرة كانت أو كبيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mention that Iblis was of the jinn resumes the question of his refusal: he was among bodily powers hidden in matter and disobeyed through material veiling.
rows.anchor: من القوى البدنية المختفية بالمواد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The outward account of Moses and his youth is accepted as told, and the miracles are not denied; inwardly Moses is the heart and his youth the self when attached to the body.
rows.anchor: ولا سبيل إلى إنكار المعجزات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart journeys until it reaches the meeting of the spirit and bodily worlds, the sweet and bitter waters within the human form, or travels for a long time.
rows.anchor: عالم الروح وعالم الجسم، وهما العذب والأجاج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At their meeting in the encompassing human form, they forget the fish associated with Jonah's fish by kind, not by individual; the fish takes a living path through the bodily sea like a broad tunnel.
rows.anchor: وهو الحوت الذي ابتلع ذا النون عليه السلام بالنوع لا بالشخص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only after passing the fish's departure does Moses feel fatigue and hunger, understood as the difficulty of birth; he asks for breakfast because this is daytime relative to the womb.
rows.anchor: ولم ينصب في السفر ولا جاع قبل ذلك على ما حكي، تذكر الحوت والاغتذاء منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rock is the neck for nursing; the youth forgot the fish because the self no longer needed it, while Moses was asleep as it escaped.
rows.anchor: إذ أوينا إلى الصخرة } أي: النحر للارتضاع { فإني نسيت الحوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youth's Satan is delusive imagination, which caused forgetting in a state of distraction; the remarkable tunnel is the fish's previously described path.
rows.anchor: أنسى شيطان الوهم الذي زين الشجرة لآدم ذكر النفس الحوت لموسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fish's escape and return to its nature identify the meeting place where Moses was promised someone more knowledgeable; perfection requires following the holy intellect there.
rows.anchor: تملص الحوت واتخاذه سبيله الذي كان عليه في جبلته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their retracing is ascent toward primordial nature; they find the holy intellect, a servant given special mercy and immaterial, direction-free spiritual perfection.
rows.anchor: وهو عبد من عباد الله مخصوص بمزية عناية ورحمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant receives sacred knowledge and universal truths directly from God, without human instruction.
rows.anchor: من المعارف القدسية والحقائق الكلية اللدنية بلا واسطة تعليم بشري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's request to follow is the heart's wish for spiritual ascent; he cannot patiently accompany the holy intellect because bodily attachment hides unseen realities, while his promise expresses readiness and sincere intent.
rows.anchor: لعدم تجردك واحتجابك بالبدن وغواشيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following the path of perfection requires imitation, practice, disciplines, character training, and struggle rather than demanding truths before their time; the realities are disclosed when bodily and heart practices prepare one.
rows.anchor: عليك بالاقتداء والمتابعة في السير بالأعمال والرياضات والأخلاق والمجاهدات، ولا تطلب الحقائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boat is the body, disciplined for servitude and travel to the holy realm through matter; damaging it means reducing food and weakening its order through ascetic practice.
rows.anchor: في سفينة البدن البالغ إلى حد الرياضة الصالح للعبودية إلى العالم القدسي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's protest that the boat will drown its people voices the fear of killing animal and vegetative powers; it is the self reasserting its traits and resenting lost pleasures.
rows.anchor: لتغرق القوى الحيوانية والنباتية التي فيها في بحر الهيولى فتهلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The holy intellect's reminder strengthens resolve; Moses's excuse for forgetting belongs to the reproachful self.
rows.anchor: تنبيه روحي وتحريض قدسي على أن العزيمة في السلوك يجب أن تكون أقوى من ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The slain boy is the self when its traits veil the heart; killing it means extinguishing anger, desire, and other traits, while the objection voices the heart's compassion for the self.
rows.anchor: هو النفس التي تظهر بصفاتها فتحجب القلب فتكون أمارة بالسوء. وقتله بإماتة الغضب والشهوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's renewed protest and apology are spiritual fluctuation, confession, and admission of fault while the self is reproachful.
rows.anchor: اعتذار وإقرار بالذنب واعتراف، وكلها من التلوينات عند كون النفس لوامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The village is the body's faculties, and their food is spiritual insight extracted through them from particular perceptions; they now refuse because the travelers' nourishment comes from higher lights, not from below.
rows.anchor: استطعامهما منهم هو طلب الغذاء الروحاني منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the boat's discipline and the boy's death, faculties and senses obstruct rather than support; they become usable only when quiet and asleep.
rows.anchor: والقوى والحواس مانعة من ذلك لا ممدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wall is the weakened, inert tranquil self that nearly collapses after the commanding self is killed; the rational power rebuilds it with virtues replacing vices, while Moses's request for payment is a heart-level fluctuation seeking reward.
rows.anchor: هو النفس المطمئنة وإنما عبر عنها بالجدار لأنها حدثت بعد قتل النفس الأمارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disciplining the self and acquiring virtuous character must not aim at a reward; actions done for an external purpose are veils and vices, not genuine virtues.
rows.anchor: فإن عمارة النفس بالرياضة والتخلق بالأخلاق الحميدة ليست لتوقع الثواب والأجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The goal is to remove the veil of the self, receive hidden realities, embody divine qualities, and realize God after annihilation, rather than gain recompense.
rows.anchor: بل الاتصاف بالصفات الإلهية بل التحقق بالله بعد الفناء فيه لا الثواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The explanation of the incidents becomes available only once the self is tranquil and the faculties settled enough to receive hidden knowledge.
rows.anchor: لما اطمأنت النفس واستقرت القوى أمكنك قبول المعاني وتلقي الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boat's poor are bodily powers, including outer senses and vegetative faculties, weak and fixed to the body's soil; the ten brothers may symbolize five impaired and five working senses, outward and inward.
rows.anchor: القوى البدنية من الحواس الظاهرة والقوى الطبيعية النباتية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The king is the commanding self ahead of them, which seizes every boat by dominating the faculties for its desires; discipline damages the boat to keep it from seizure.
rows.anchor: ملك النفس الأمارة غصبا وهو الملك الذي كان وراءهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boy's parents are spirit and bodily nature, faithful through obedience; they fear the boy's self-assertion and ingratitude would corrupt their servitude and veil them.
rows.anchor: مقرين بالتوحيد لانقيادهما في سلك طاعة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The commanding self is replaced by the purer tranquil self, more merciful and helpful to spirit and body.
rows.anchor: كما بدلهما بالنفس المطمئنة التي هي خير منه زكاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the parents are the grandfather and father, symbolizing spirit and heart; greater mercy is especially fitting for them.
rows.anchor: المراد بالأبوين الجد والأب، فكان كناية عن الروح والقلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wall belongs to two orphaned rational faculties cut off from the holy spirit by bodily veils, or to a heart that died before perfection under the self's domination; their treasure is knowledge available at maturity in the heart.
rows.anchor: العاقلتين النظرية والعملية المنقطعتين عن أبيهما الذي هو روح القدس

rows.speaker: بعض أهل الظاهر من المفسرين
rows.claim: Some outward interpreters say the treasure was pages containing knowledge.
rows.anchor: وقال بعض أهل الظاهر من المفسرين: كان الكنز صحفا فيها علم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The righteous father is the father above the two faculties, who preserved them; on that reading he can only be the holy spirit.
rows.anchor: كان أبا أعلى لهما حفظهما الله له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dhū al-Qarnayn inwardly is the heart controlling its two horns, east and west; empowered in the body's land, it can gather meanings and seek whichever perfection it wants.
rows.anchor: إن ذا القرنين في هذا الوجود هو القلب الذي ملك قرنيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His westward journey is the spirit's sunset into mixed bodily matter; the peoples there are bodily and spiritual faculties, which the heart can discipline harshly or balance kindly.
rows.anchor: مكان غروب شمس الروح { وجدها تغرب في عين حمئة }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wrongdoing is excess without surrender, as with desire, anger, imagination, and fantasy; the heart first disciplines such traits, then their return to their Lord brings the harsher fire of nature in the minor resurrection or annihilating divine overpowering in the major resurrection.
rows.anchor: بالإفراط وعدم الاستسلام والانقياد كالشهوة والغضب والوهم والتخيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who believe through knowledge and work virtuously by acquiring traits of excellence and obedience receive the garden of attributes, their lights, and streams of knowledge.
rows.anchor: بالسعي في اكتساب الفضائل والانقياد والطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ruler speaks an easy word by which excellent character dispositions are attained.
rows.anchor: قولا ذا يسر بحصول الملكات الفاضلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Further ascent and purification reaches the dawn of the spirit's sun, shining on the two rational faculties, thought, intuition, and holy power without a veil; God alone encompasses the heart's knowledge as the universal station.
rows.anchor: هم العاقلتان والفكر والحدس و القوة القدسية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two barriers are the two worlds; the heart's original station lies between them, while those beyond are bodily powers and external senses unable to understand or express meanings.
rows.anchor: الكونين، وذلك مرتبته ومقامه الأصلي بين صدفي جبلي الإله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gog and Magog are delusive impulses and imaginative whispers that corrupt the bodily realm, urge vice and appetite, and disrupt just order; the powers ask the heart to make a barrier against them.
rows.anchor: في أرض البدن بالتحريض على الرذائل والشهوات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart says God-given meanings gathered by experience and travel are better than payment, then asks for effort and obedience to build practical wisdom and religious law as a barrier against destructive impulses.
rows.anchor: من المعاني الكلية والجزئية الحاصلة بالتجربة والسير في المشرق والمغرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The iron pieces are practical forms of action; breath into them adds meanings and virtuous dispositions, fire makes their account a science, and poured copper represents intention joining knowledge's spirit to action's body.
rows.anchor: من الصور العملية وأوضاع الأعمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The resulting barrier is a settled base of actions, knowledge, character, and intention; established proof prevents impulses from mastering or penetrating it, reinforced by habits, deeds, and remembrance.
rows.anchor: فحصل سد، أي: قاعدة وبنيان من زبر الأعمال ونفخ العلوم والأخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The barrier is a mercy from God that secures people, but at the minor resurrection it collapses because work ceases with death and the body's faculties break down.
rows.anchor: القانون { رحمة من ربي } على عباده، يوجب أمنهم وبقاءهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At resurrection, people mingle in confusion when gathered together; alternatively, at the major resurrection they are confused in annihilation and the barrier of wisdom disappears as divine acts appear.
rows.anchor: تركناهم يختلطون لاجتماعهم في الروح مع عدم الحيلولة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the major abiding state, all are gathered in unity, uprightness, and stability through God rather than themselves.
rows.anchor: في التوحيد والاستقامة والتمكين وكونهم بالله لا بأنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the minor resurrection, those veiled from truth suffer the forms of fire; in the great witnessing, the possessor of that resurrection sees their torment in Hell.
rows.anchor: يوم القيامة الصغرى يتعذب المحجوبون عن الحق بأنواع العذاب والنيران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their eyes were veiled from God's signs and manifestations of attributes that call Him to mind.
rows.anchor: محجوبة عن آياتي وتجليات صفاتي الموجبة لذكري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fully prepared monotheists do not seek to leave their station because it fulfills their capacity and they cannot perceive or desire any higher one; their garden of the highest degree confirms this reading.
rows.anchor: تحولا لبلوغهم الكمال الذي يقتضيه استعدادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sea is receptive matter that gives forms their appearance; even if it became ink, it would run out before the limitless divine meanings, truths, entities, and spirits.
rows.anchor: بحر الهيولى القابلة للصور الممدة لها في الظهور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A supplicant is answered when their state calls upon God and invokes the name that supplies their need, whether knowingly or not; giving corresponds to inherent readiness and its required divine name.
rows.anchor: كل طالب ينادي ربه ويدعوه إنما يستحق الإجابة إذا دعاه بلسان الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For example, a sick person implicitly asks the Healer, and a poor person asks the Enricher; God answers each by that name.
rows.anchor: إذ الحق يبريه بذلك الاسم عند إجابته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zechariah seeks a successor for religious leadership, appealing to his weakness and age and to God's past care; he fears unsuitable relatives and notes his wife's barrenness.
rows.anchor: توسل بالضعف والشيخوخة والوهن والعجز عن القيام بأمر الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His weakness elicits the name al-Kafi, which supplies strength and a son; recalling that he was never disappointed elicits al-Hadi and guidance through the promised good news.
rows.anchor: فأجابه باسمه الكافي فكفاه ضعفه وأعطاه القوة وأيده بالولد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear of his relatives elicits the protecting name, and his wife's barrenness elicits the knowing name: divine knowledge overrides apparent missing causes and what God knows must come to be.
rows.anchor: فأجابه باسمه الواقي، فوقاه شرهم، وبامتناع وجود الولي من نسله لعدم الأسباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Primordial care is God's eternal knowledge of a nonexistent individual's readiness and fitting happiness; guidance realizes that destined perfection by arranging the needed causes.
rows.anchor: بعين في العدم وتقتضي باستعدادها سعادة تناسبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though Zechariah repeats the lack of natural causes because of his attachment to worldly causation, God reassures him of His power and gives the promised child Yahya.
rows.anchor: تعجب منه لضراوته في عالم الأسباب بالحكمة وكرر التعلل بعدم الأسباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The five letters in Kaf-Ha-Ya-Ayn-Sad signify the five names required by Zechariah's states—Sufficient, Guide, Protector, Knower, and Truthful—together constituting mercy through Yahya's gift.
rows.anchor: فعلى هذا يكون (ك) إشارة إلى الكافي

rows.speaker: ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses the five letters respectively as the Sufficient, Guide, Protector, Knower, and Truthful.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: (ك) عبارة عن الكافي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letters enumerate the attributes whose manifestation was mercy to Zechariah and produced Yahya; naming them recalls that mercy.
rows.anchor: إلى أن ظهور هذه الصفات التي حصل بها هذه الأسماء هو ظهور رحمة عبده زكريا
